newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Goldstream in alliance with Minorco.
newsitem.headline: Goldstream in alliance with Minorco.

text.p: Goldstream Mining NL said on Tuesday it had signed a strategic alliance agreement with Minorco Investments (Australia) Ltd, a wholly owned subsidiary of international natural resources group Minorco SA.

"The agreement will help Goldstream to explore and develop its large tenement positions in South Australia and Tasmania, and allow Goldstream to pursue new exploration opportunities in Australia," the company said.

Goldstream said the agreement would also give Goldstream an opportunity to access Minorco's technical services, obtain Minorco's assistance in exploration and development of tenements and participate with Minorco, at Minorco's discretion, as the Luxembourg-listed company developed its business in Australia.
Minorco would subscribe for an allotment of shares equal to 9.31 percent of Goldstream's issued capital.
A total of 6.79 million shares would be issued be at a price of 58 cents, raising A$3.94 million.
The stock last traded at 56 cents on Monday.

Under the terms of the agreement, Minorco may for at least a period of 3-1/2 years, participate in prospects on any of Goldstream's tenements. Goldstream would remain as operator during the discovery phase.

"Goldstream will retain not less than 75 percent of any discoveries with resources of less than 1.5 million ounces of gold, notwithstanding that Minorco may have funded 100 percent of exploration expenditure to pre-feasibility or feasibility completion," Goldstream said.

"In the event of discoveries with resources in excess of 1.5 million ounces of gold, Goldstream will be free carried to feasibility completion and will retain an interest of between 30-40 percent dependent on Minorco's entry point," it said.
Goldstream, capitalised at about A$39 million, said it welcomed the support of Minorco and believed the agreement would provide significant benefits and growth opportunities for Goldstream.

"Minorco's involvement as a shareholder is seen by Goldstream as an endorsement of Goldstream's management and exploration strategy, and an acknowledgement that Goldstream's exploration areas have the potential to host world class ore bodies," the company said.
Minorco is a European-based, diversified natural resources group with operating assets in mining, agribusiness and paper in Europe and the Americas. Sales in 1996 totalled US$5 billion.
Minorco produced 828,000 ounces of gold in 1996 and has a global exploration budget of about US$50 million.
